context: Tests the reuse gate and the no-skinning guardrail: a section whose authoring model matches an existing block but whose visual styling diverges (dark background, light text, no matching variant) must NOT reuse the block as-is and must NOT be made to fit by editing the shared block or global CSS. Also tests that the legibility check covers every text element over the media/fill (not just the heading) and that flagging the problem in the plan is not treated as satisfying the check. Guards against the single most common autonomous-run failure: skinning a shared block, or logging an illegibility caveat and shipping anyway.

checklist.name: Rejects reuse-as-is
checklist.description: Concludes the section cannot reuse the existing cards block as-is, because a matching authoring model is not sufficient when the rendered look diverges from the design.

checklist.name: Cites structural AND visual fit requirement
checklist.description: States the reuse rule explicitly: reuse requires both structural fit and visual fit (using only the block's defined variants), including how it treats secondary text and CTAs over the background.

checklist.name: Forbids skinning shared code
checklist.description: States the agent must NOT modify the shared cards block implementation, scripts.js, or head.html, and must NOT add section- or block-specific rules to global CSS, to force the look.

checklist.name: Correct resolution: new isolated block or variant
checklist.description: Gives the correct resolution: build a new isolated block (or a new dark variant as its own block/variant) via the content+code path (Phase 3B), and author content into it.

checklist.name: Distinguishes allowed token retheme from disallowed restyle
checklist.description: Notes that retargeting the global design tokens (the one allowed global change) is different from restyling this specific block, which is not allowed and points to a new block.

checklist.name: Legibility check covers all text over media
checklist.description: Describes a legibility check that covers every text element rendered over the dark background — headings AND secondary/body text, links/CTAs, and list items — not just the heading.

checklist.name: A plan note is not a check
checklist.description: States that flagging the divergence/illegibility in the plan does not satisfy the gate — it must be resolved (new block/variant), and an unresolved item blocks publish (preview-only), never ships.
